contract_signature_evidence.name: contract_signature_evidence
contract_signature_evidence.value: ("contract_signature"."source" = 'client' AND "contract_signature"."signed_name" IS NOT NULL) OR ("contract_signature"."source" = 'studio' AND "contract_signature"."note" IS NOT NULL)

deliverable_version_has_content.name: deliverable_version_has_content
deliverable_version_has_content.value: "deliverable_version"."link_url" IS NOT NULL OR "deliverable_version"."file_id" IS NOT NULL

deliverable_version_decision_shape.name: deliverable_version_decision_shape
deliverable_version_decision_shape.value: ("deliverable_version"."status" IN ('approved', 'changes_requested')) = ("deliverable_version"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "deliverable_version"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "deliverable_version"."decision_source" IS NOT NULL AND "deliverable_version"."signer_email" IS NOT NULL AND "deliverable_version"."statement" IS NOT NULL)

deliverable_version_decision_evidence.name: deliverable_version_decision_evidence
deliverable_version_decision_evidence.value: "deliverable_version"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'changes_requested') OR ("deliverable_version"."decision_source" = 'client' AND ("deliverable_version"."status" = 'changes_requested' OR "deliverable_version"."signed_name" IS NOT NULL)) OR ("deliverable_version"."decision_source" = 'studio' AND "deliverable_version"."decision_note" IS NOT NULL)

invoice_sent_has_dates.name: invoice_sent_has_dates
invoice_sent_has_dates.value: "invoice"."status" = 'draft' OR ("invoice"."issued_on" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice"."due_on" IS NOT NULL)

invoice_paid_has_details.name: invoice_paid_has_details
invoice_paid_has_details.value: "invoice"."status" <> 'paid' OR ("invoice"."paid_on" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice"."paid_method" IS NOT NULL)

milestone_signoff_evidence.name: milestone_signoff_evidence
milestone_signoff_evidence.value: ("milestone_signoff"."source" = 'client' AND "milestone_signoff"."initials" IS NOT NULL) OR ("milestone_signoff"."source" = 'studio' AND "milestone_signoff"."note" IS NOT NULL)
